purpose: Prevent public drone/rotor recordings from being promoted to a release acoustic profile without the evidence required by decisions D057-D061.
eligibility_rule: release_profile_eligible is true if and only if every hard gate is true.

datasets.name: Experimental noise characterisation of different blade numbers, diameters, and pitches of the propeller in forward flight
datasets.license: Non-Commercial Government Licence for public sector information
admissible_uses: blade-count, diameter, pitch, RPM and inflow sensitivity
blocking_reasons: The public operating-point hierarchy is not a synchronized tach trace accepted by the current recording analyzer.
The licence is non-commercial.
The tested isolated propellers and operating range do not identify the target 5-inch three-blade FPV airframe.

datasets.name: NEAPTIDE drone noise dataset
blocking_reasons: No synchronized measured rotor-speed trace is provided.
Motor and propeller identity is insufficient for a target profile.
The licence is non-commercial and the aircraft are not the target 5-inch FPV platform.

datasets.name: DroneNoise Database v3
blocking_reasons: No synchronized measured rotor-speed trace is provided.
Propeller and motor metadata is insufficient for order-source fitting.
The flight vehicles do not identify the target 5-inch FPV configuration.

datasets.name: NASA Small UAS Flyover Acoustics Data
datasets.license: Not specified by the dataset catalog
admissible_uses: position, attitude and microphone geometry replay
blocking_reasons: Vehicle state contains position and attitude but no rotor-speed trace.
Propeller and motor identity is insufficient for a target source profile.
The catalog does not specify a reuse licence and the vehicles are not the target 5-inch FPV platform.

datasets.name: Drone Authentication via Acoustic Fingerprint
blocking_reasons: The WAV recordings do not provide an absolute pressure calibration chain or synchronized rotor speed.
Model/state/distance labels are not complete propulsion metadata.
The corpus is not a calibrated target-domain bench campaign.

datasets.name: Drone Detection and Localization dataset
blocking_reasons: The field recordings are not an absolute-pressure, synchronized-RPM source experiment.
Drone model labels do not provide complete propulsion metadata.
The DJI platforms are not the target 5-inch FPV configuration.

datasets.name: DroneAudioSet
blocking_reasons: The public audio is offset-corrected and resampled to 16 kHz; the 48 kHz raw recordings are available only by author request.
Throttle class and inferred spectral fundamentals are not synchronized measured rotor speed.
Reported dBA levels do not establish a recoverable per-recording pressure calibration chain for the released files.
The F330/F450 platforms are not the target 5-inch FPV configuration.

datasets.name: Experimental Acoustic Investigation of Rotor Noise Directivity and Decay in Multiple Configurations
datasets.license: Article CC BY 4.0; raw-data terms not stated
admissible_uses: isolated, plate-installed and four-rotor reduced-order validation
blocking_reasons: The article states that raw data are available from the authors on request, not in a public repository.
The raw-data reuse terms are not stated.
The Intel Aero-derived two-blade platform is not the target 5-inch three-blade FPV configuration.

datasets.name: Serration Manufacturing Effects on Propeller Trailing Edge Noise Mechanisms dataset
blocking_reasons: The release provides processed acoustic autopower in Pa^2 versus frequency, not the 16-second pressure time histories.
RPM-indexed spectra are not a synchronized tach trace accepted by the current recording analyzer.
No separate background/noise-floor product is documented.
The isolated serrated rotor is not the target 5-inch FPV airframe.
